==Format==

The tournament consists of a round robin stage with {{Abbr/Bo3}} matches followed by a single grand finals {{Abbr/Bo5}} match between the top two teams. It is intended that teams play a minimum of one game per week. A point is awarded for each map won.

Refer to the [[SundaySpawnfraggin18/Standings|the detailed results in the standings]] for the schedule and to the [[SundaySpawnfraggin18/Rules|rules]] for more details.
